name: AMA.ZO Cozinha Peruana
notes: Michelin Bib Gourmand 2025. Chef Enrique Paredes. Two locations: Pátio Higienópolis and Casa de Don'Anna in Campos Elíseos. Only Peruvian restaurant in Brazil with Bib Gourmand.

name: Fish-Wan
notes: Japanese omakase restaurant inside the Vila Anália gastronomy complex in the East Zone. Part of a multi-restaurant group with French, Italian, Greek, and Japanese options.

name: Dinho's Paraíso
notes: Michelin-recognized institution. Upscale steakhouse and seafood in traditional Paraíso neighborhood. Long-standing fine dining establishment in São Paulo.

name: Ruella Bistrô
notes: Contemporary French-Brazilian bistro in Vila Olímpia. Elegant ambiance with a focused seasonal menu.

name: Barú Marisqueria
notes: Michelin-recognized seafood restaurant in Villa San Pietro on Rua Augusta. Chef Dagoberto Torres. Latin American-inspired seafood with strong Brazilian identity.

name: Cozinha 212
notes: Mediterranean-inspired restaurant focused on charcoal cooking and fresh seafood. Located in Pinheiros with creative menu and good wine list.

name: Yorimichi Izakaya
notes: Authentic Japanese izakaya in Paraíso neighborhood. Traditional Japanese small plates, yakitori, and sake selection.

name: Vicolo Nostro
emailSource: Confirmed via multiple sources including official website
notes: Northern Italian trattoria in Brooklin. Handmade pastas, risottos, and regional Italian specialties. Intimate setting.

name: Pobre Juan
notes: Michelin-recognized Argentine steakhouse. Premium cuts, empanadas, and Argentine wine selection. Multiple São Paulo locations.

name: Lolla Meets Fire
notes: Upscale Italian-inspired restaurant in Itaim Bibi combining premium meats and fresh seafood with fire/grill techniques. Part of the Lolla group.

name: Amani Restaurante
notes: Sophisticated Arabic restaurant inside Estádio do Morumbi. Upscale Middle Eastern cuisine with lamb, kebabs, and mezze. Unique venue inside a football stadium.

name: Iulia Gastronomia
notes: Contemporary Brazilian cuisine. New Itaim Bibi location opened 2024 with open-air terrace. Also operates inside the historic Jockey Club de São Paulo. Brothers Rodrigo and Ricardo Lima.

name: Nakombi Vila Olímpia
emailSource: Multiple sources including official site listing (nakombi.com.br) and BaresSP
notes: Pioneer Japanese restaurant in Vila Olímpia since 1997. One of the first Japanese restaurants outside Liberdade in São Paulo. Now has multiple locations. Japanese cuisine with premium imported ingredients.

name: Kaori Sushi
emailSource: Multiple sources confirming email; team with 25+ years experience
notes: Japanese restaurant in Perdizes specializing in authentic omakase. Name means 'delicious aroma'. Daily fresh fish. Exclusive chef-selected omakase with appetizers, sushi, sashimi, and dessert.

name: Bottega Bernacca
notes: Premium Italian restaurant since 2013 with multiple São Paulo locations (Jardins, Itaim, JK Iguatemi, Ibirapuera). Precisely cooked pasta with balanced sauces. Intimate atmosphere with low lighting.

name: Bistrot de Paris
emailSource: Official website (bistrotdeparis.com.br) - email appears in footer and multiple sections
notes: Michelin Guide restaurant. Chef Alain Poletto. Classic French cuisine in Villa San Pietro on Rua Augusta. Traditional recipes with top-quality ingredients. Also events email: eventos@bistrotdeparis.com.br.

name: Enosteria Vino e Cucina
notes: Italian and Mediterranean cuisine with integrated World Wine wine shop featuring 2,000+ labels. Located on Rua Jacques Félix in Vila Nova Conceição. Also serves delivery. Inspired by the Puglia region of Italy.

name: Su Restaurante
notes: Modern Japanese restaurant by Attivo Group inside Shopping Pátio Higienópolis. Sushi bar and dining room with 72 seats. Contemporary Japanese cuisine.

name: Nakka
emailSource: Multiple sources including BaresSP listing and ZoomInfo
notes: Upscale Japanese restaurant by sushiman Hermes Takeda. Two units in Itaim Bibi (Rua Pedroso Alvarenga, 890) and Jardins (Padre João Manuel, 811). Fine Japanese cuisine with contemporary presentation.

name: Takô
notes: Traditional Japanese restaurant in Liberdade neighborhood. Classic Japanese cuisine including sushi, sashimi, and hot dishes. Beloved neighborhood institution.

name: Dedo de La Chica
notes: Established Mexican restaurant in Vila Madalena for 10+ years. Rua Fidalga, 32. Typical Mexican cuisine with tacos, burritos, enchiladas, guacamole, and churros. Casual and welcoming atmosphere.

name: Kinoshita
emailSource: Confirmed via official website and multiple search sources
notes: Michelin 1 star 2025. Kappo-style Japanese cuisine — the only Krug Ambassade in South America. Rua Jacques Félix, 405 in Vila Nova Conceição. Refined counter-style dining experience.
